title: Tim Can Not See the Cat
lines: Tim can not see the cat.
"Is it in the tub?" said Mom.
Tim did not see it in the tub.
"Is it in the bin?" said Mom.
Tim did see a mop and a big bag.
The bag did tip and a cat got up!
The cat sat on Tim and did nap.

questions.listenFor: In the big bag. The story says it. If your child says the tub, read the line about the bag again together.

questions.ask: How did Tim find the cat?
questions.listenFor: The bag tipped and the cat got up. Listen for the bag tipping - that is what gave the cat away.

questions.ask: Where do you think the cat will hide next? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no wrong answer. You are listening for a reason from the story - cats like small dark spots, or it will pick a new one now.
